thread:
maria: Quick sync — planning a tenant migration for tenant=acme from eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 to satisfy data residency. Proposed high-level sequence: 1) consent check, 2) quiesce writes, 3) snapshot/kvsnapshot, 4) warm KV + prefix priming, 5) switch write lease, 6) smoke tests, 7) unquiesce. any missing steps?
sam: Are we gating on customer consent header or org-level flag? if consent missing we need to keep in-place and provide a migration rejection response. :thinking:
jonathan: must be org-level opt-in + per-tenant consent header fallback. Also add a circuit-breaker that prevents automatic writes if the target region KMS health is degraded. We saw failures when KMS latency spiked.
kevin: +1. Also call out idempotency for the migration API. If the operator retries, the sequencing must be safe. suggest an idempotency_key on /admin/migrate and a migration state machine: pending -> snapshotting -> priming -> active -> rollback.
kevin: snippet for the admin call:
```
POST /admin/migrate
{
  "tenant": "acme",
  "target_region": "eu-central-1",
  "idempotency_key": "mig-2026-03-21-acme-01",
  "consent": "org:true"
}
```
maria: good. what about reads during the switch? we planned to keep reads on source for a minute then gradually steer. need to avoid split-read anomalies for short TTL tokens.
jonathan: do staged-read-steering: 100% reads source -> 90/10 -> 75/25 -> 50/50 -> 0/100 over a few minutes with canary traffic first (10 requests/s). instrument skew metric: last_write_ts difference, and a "stale-read" counter.
sam: rollback plan if priming fails? simplest is revert route and keep the snapshot for replay later. but operators want a fast abort path. propose: if priming fails > threshold or smoke tests fail, immediately flip reads back to source and set write-mode=read-only until manual operator ok.
kevin: cache priming notes: we should pre-populate hot prefixes only. don't bulk-hydrate entire tenant KV (costly). use background priming with a concurrency limiter and backoff. sample priming command: `replay-prefix --tenant acme --prefix user:session --concurrency 8`
ops-bot: deploybot: migration-canary job started for tenant=acme against eu-central-1, canary 100 reqs queued, timeout=120s.
maria: perfect — once canary passes we'll move to staged read steering and then lease swap. checklist for next meeting: add consent gating test, KMS latency injection, idempotency retry test, & operator rollback drill. assigning action items: @kevin write priming throttler docs, @jonathan add KMS failure mode in runbook, @sam draft consent test vectors. :white_check_mark:
jonathan: one more — audit trail must include pre-snapshot checksum and post-apply checksum for verification. log to audit.kv with signature from KMS.
maria: noted. i'll schedule a short runbook dry-run Wed 09:30. thanks all :)
